primaryTextRead.text: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in slinging stones and in shooting arrows from the bow. They were of Saul’s relatives of the tribe of Benjamin.
The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; Beracah; Jehu the Anathothite;
Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty and a leader of the thirty; Jeremiah; Jahaziel; Johanan; Jozabad the Gederathite;
Eluzai; Jerimoth; Bealiah; Shemariah; Shephatiah the Haruphite;

wikipediaRead.locator: A–K一覧のJozabad節4392–4396行。1 Chronicles 12:4のJozabad of GederahをDavidの戦士として区別し、別の同名者も列挙する。
wikipediaRead.supportSummaryJa: 英語版の人物一覧は、ゲデラのヨザバドをダビデの戦士として歴代誌上12:4に挙げています。
wikipediaRead.identityAssessmentJa: WEB 12:4の表記Jozabad the Gederathiteに対し、一覧のJozabad of Gederahが同じ節を明示する。複数のJozabadを区別している。
